questions.given: In triangle ABC, AB = AC, and point D is the midpoint of side BC.
questions.short: İkizkenar üçgende tabana çizilen kenarortay aynı zamanda yüksekliktir.

questions.stem: Coins are available in values of 5 cents, 10 cents, and 25 cents. What is the least number of coins that have a total value of 85 cents?
If 1a + 1b = 12 and ab = 12, what is the value of a + b?
A team of 5 people is to be chosen from 6 men and 5 women. How many different teams include exactly 3 women?

questions.expl: Üçgen: 0 < x < 10. Geniş açı ancak x'in karşısında olabilir (5'in karşısındaki açı tabandaki eşit açılardan biri, geniş olamaz): x² > 25 + 25 = 50 → x ≥ 8. 8 ve 9 ✓; 10 dejenere ✗; 7 dar açılı.
questions.fig: Figure not drawn to scale.
questions.stem:
A triangle has sides of lengths 5, 5, and x, where x is an integer, and one of its angles is obtuse. Which of the following could be the value of x?
Indicate all such values.
Which of the following is closest to 49.8 × 0.201?
If f(x) = x2 + 1 and g(x) = 2x − 3, what is the value of f(g(3))?

questions.short: En yüksek çubuk medyanı göstermeyebilir (burada tesadüfen aynı).
questions.stem: In which interval, in minutes, is the median commute time of the 100 workers?
What percent of the 100 workers have a commute time of at least 30 minutes?
